reuse.why: Routes set3/6/12MonthAvg through the existing setNMonthAvg and adds one category-selection helper, but copyPreviousMonth does not use that helper.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied average loops and the copied category query, but the eligibility rule is still written twice: in getMonthWideCategories and again as hidden/group_hidden/has_template checks in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection and actions stay in server/budget/actions.ts, beside the month-wide actions that use them.

scope.why: Focused on the month-wide actions; folding set3MonthAvg into setNMonthAvg is a related cleanup, not an unrelated edit.

maintainability.why: A named selection function makes the rule easy to find, though a maintainer has to remember that copyPreviousMonth applies the same rule separately through getBudgetData columns.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth repeats the eligibility rule as getBudgetData columns (hidden, group_hidden, has_template computed as goal_def IS NOT NULL) plus early returns, a reshaped version of getMonthWideCategories' WHERE clause

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories serves setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg; copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/template rule in its own loop through new has_template column in getBudgetData
